promptSet.description:
Claude Fable 5 Dev Workflow – Mastering Claude Fable 5 for Complex Software Engineering

If you're a developer still using basic chat windows, you're working too hard. Harness Claude Fable 5's massive context window to ingest entire multi-repo codebases, conduct root-cause debugging, and generate regression tests.

Designed for developers and engineering teams, Claude Fable 5 Dev Workflow accelerates implementation, eliminates repetitive development friction, and streamlines day-to-day coding workflows.

Key Features:
• Upload your project files into Claude Fable 5 project knowledge.
• Run the prompt to generate exhaustive unit and integration tests.
• Verify the test suite passes locally in your terminal.
• Complete Vitest test suite covering edge cases with 95%+ branch coverage.

Official Website: https://claude.ai/
Instagram Breakdown: https://www.instagram.com/p/DaW9ie0PvNY/
